title: Front-end delivery
description: For a change to the user interface: every state designed and built, a supported browser list, a bundle size budget and client error reporting.

rules.instruction: Build the loading, empty, error and partial states of each data-driven view the change adds or modifies.
rules.verification: Check the component stories or screenshots for each of the four states.

rules.instruction: Keep the list of supported browsers and devices in the repository and check that the platform features the change uses work in all of them or have a fallback.
rules.verification: Open the supported browser list and check the test results or fallback for features the change uses.

rules.instruction: Measure the JavaScript and CSS the change adds and compare it with the budget set for the affected pages.
rules.verification: Read the bundle size report in CI for the change and compare it with the budget.

rules.instruction: Send browser errors to the monitoring service with the release version.
rules.verification: Trigger a test error in a staging build and check that it appears in monitoring with the version.
